label: Gmail Reader
description: An open email in a full Gmail window: logo + search bar, sidebar with Compose pill and Inbox count, message toolbar, External/Inbox chips, reply pills, and a marker-sweep highlight over the money quote. Use when the film should say 'this is your real inbox'; email-reader is the generic sibling for a tighter closeup.

body.label: Body
body.description: Email body; paragraphs split on newlines. Mark the money quote with *asterisks* (or use highlight_quote).

highlight_quote.label: Highlight quote
highlight_quote.description: Exact substring of the body to sweep with the marker highlight. Ignored if the body already carries *asterisk* marks or the substring is not found.

inbox_count.label: Inbox count
inbox_count.description: Unread count shown beside Inbox in the sidebar (default 2008).

external.label: External chip
external.description: Show the yellow External chip beside the subject (default true).

script_actions.description: Click a toolbar action, sidebar item, or reply pill
